Failed_to_start_the_speech_recognizer_Pr.description: Failed to start the speech recognizer. Probably you are not connected to the internet. Please check your internet connection and try again. Otherwise, try changing your voice control language from settings.
Failed_to_start_the_speech_recognizer_Pr.message: Imeshindwa kuanzisha kitambua sauti. Labda hujaunganishwa kwenye intaneti. Tafadhali angalia muunganisho wako wa intaneti na jaribu tena. Vinginevyo, jaribu kubadilisha lugha ya udhibiti wa sauti kutoka kwenye mipangilio.

Hear_messages_automatically.description: Read new messages aloud automatically as they appear
Hear_messages_automatically.message: Soma ujumbe mpya kwa sauti kiotomatiki

Incorrect_credentials_or_your_subscripti.description: Incorrect credentials or your subscription has expired. Please contact us if you need assistance.

It_appears_that_this_extension_couldn_t_.description: It appears that this extension couldn't find any connected microphone. Please ensure that your microphone is connected and working properly.
It_appears_that_this_extension_couldn_t_.message: Inaonekana kwamba kiendelezi hiki hakikuweza kupata maikrofoni yoyote iliyounganishwa. Tafadhali hakikisha kwamba maikrofoni yako imeunganishwa na inafanya kazi vizuri.

It_seems_like_microphone_access_is_denie.description: It seems like microphone access is denied. To enable speech recognition, please go to your browser's microphone settings and allow the extension access to the microphone.
It_seems_like_microphone_access_is_denie.message: Inaonekana ufikiaji wa maikrofoni umekataliwa. Ili kuwezesha utambuzi wa sauti, tafadhali nenda kwenye mipangilio ya maikrofoni ya kivinjari chako na uruhusu kipengele hiki kufikia maikrofoni.

Learn_how_to_install_more_voices.description: Learn how to install more voices
Learn_how_to_install_more_voices.message: Jifunze jinsi ya kusakinisha sauti zaidi

Manually_update_the_selectors_configurat.description: Manually update the selectors configuration from the remote server. This ensures you have the latest integration rules for supported websites.
Manually_update_the_selectors_configurat.message: Sasisha usanidi wa vichaguzi mwenyewe kutoka kwenye seva ya mbali. Hii inahakikisha una kanuni za hivi karibuni za ujumuishaji kwa tovuti zinazotumika.

Now_you_can_use_advanced_voice_control_o.description: Now you can use advanced voice control on {{linksToAIs}} and other supported websites! Just head to the website, click the {{iconOfMicrophone}} icon, or press {{toggleKey}} from the keyboard (outside the input field) to activate voice control and begin speaking.
Now_you_can_use_advanced_voice_control_o.message: Sasa unaweza kutumia udhibiti wa kina wa sauti kwenye $linksToAIs$ na tovuti zingine zinazotumika! Nenda tu kwenye tovuti hiyo, bonyeza ikoni ya $iconOfMicrophone$, au bonyeza $toggleKey$ kwenye kibodi (nje ya sehemu ya kuingiza) ili kuamsha udhibiti wa sauti na kuanza kuzungumza.

On_Page.description: On-Page option in settings - that is voicewave for all websites

On_any_website_just_right_click_on_the_i.description: On any website just right-click on the input field, choose "Voice typing" from the menu, click the {{iconOfMicrophone}} icon, and start speaking to type without using the keyboard.
On_any_website_just_right_click_on_the_i.message: Kwenye tovuti yoyote bonyeza kulia kwenye sehemu ya kuingiza, chagua "Kuandika kwa sauti" kutoka kwenye menyu, bonyeza ikoni ya $iconOfMicrophone$, na anza kusema ili kuandika bila kutumia kibodi.

On_any_website_just_right_click_on_the_i.description: On any website just right-click on the input field, choose "{{itemTitle}}" from the menu, click the {{iconOfMicrophone}} icon, and start speaking to type without using the keyboard.
On_any_website_just_right_click_on_the_i.message: Bonyeza kitufe cha kulia kwenye sehemu ya kuingiza maandishi kwenye tovuti yoyote, uchague "$itemTitle$" kutoka kwenye menyu, bonyeza ikoni ya $iconOfMicrophone$, na uanze kutamka.

Personalize_your_experience_by_customizi.description: Personalize your experience by customizing voice commands, language, dictation settings, keyboard shortcuts, and more.
Personalize_your_experience_by_customizi.message: Weka mapendeleo yako binafsi: sauti, mipangilio ya kusoma kwa sauti, njia za mkato, n.k.

Please_sign_in_to_your_account.description: Please sign in to your account.

Speech_input_was_interrupted_or_cancelle.description: Speech input was interrupted or cancelled. Please make sure you've a working internet connection and your microphone is connected and microphone access is allowed for this extension.
Speech_input_was_interrupted_or_cancelle.message: Pembejeo la sauti limekatizwa au limefutwa. Tafadhali hakikisha una muunganisho wa intaneti unaofanya kazi na maikrofoni yako imeunganishwa na ufikiaji wa maikrofoni umeruhusu kwa kipengele hiki.

The_highness_or_lowness_of_the_voice.description: The highness or lowness of the voice.

This_feature_is_only_available_for_Elite.description: This feature is only available for Elite users.
This_feature_is_only_available_for_Elite.message: Kipengele hiki kinapatikana kwa watumiaji wa Elite tu.

This_is_a_beta_feature_It_is_still_being.description: This is a beta feature. It is still being optimized and may have some bugs or limitations.
